name: Itoshii Hito
source:
Rescue your classmate from the worst ending!! 
This is a simple and easy adventure game that the story progresses by choosing paths!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE236766.html]DLsite English[/url]]
